description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzer, which enforces correct return types for Orleans grain interface methods. It verifies that valid asynchronous return types are accepted, invalid synchronous types are flagged, and static interface methods are exempt.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzer, testing valid and invalid return types for Orleans grain interface methods.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeNoError
methods.description: Tests that valid asynchronous return types (Task, Task<T>, ValueTask, ValueTask<T>, void) are accepted without diagnostics.

methods.name: IncompatibleGrainInterfaceMethodReturnType
methods.description: Tests that a synchronous return type (int) in a grain interface method triggers a diagnostic error.

methods.name: StaticInterfaceMethodsWithRegularReturnsAreAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that static interface methods with regular return types do not trigger diagnostics, as they are not subject to grain call restrictions.
